scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT-derived effective formation energies is infeasible within the verifier sandbox. The checker reads the agent's reported energies and compares them to the paper's published relaxed N=16 values (Table 1) with tolerances and structural consistency checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold effective formation energies from the paper's Table 1 (relaxed N=16)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these values are directly the paper's reported results

outputs.description: Effective formation energies for six defect types at three compositions (x=70,75,80) for the relaxed N=16 supercell, computed from DFT total energies via the grand-canonical formalism.

output_contract.notes: Energies must be derived solely from the DFT calculations; no external energy references are allowed.

steps.description: Compare the three vacancy formation energies at x=75 against the paper's relaxed N=16 values within ±0.1 eV
Verify that the structural antisite defects (Fe_antisite_Al and Al_antisite_Fe_gamma) have energies ≤ 0.2 eV for all three compositions
Check that the Fe_vac_alpha effective formation energy varies only weakly across compositions (population std. dev. ≤ 0.05 eV)
